description: Editorial headings and selected exact captured output. Countdown accelerated; idle waits and package chatter omitted. source_time is seconds into rclone-root-full.cast. Text wraps only; no invented telemetry.

frames.title: 02  Choose a full backup instead of discarding data
frames.body:
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
!! WARNING: ROOT IS AT LEAST 50% USED. PRESERVATION IS NOT ELIGIBLE.     !!
!! A: rclone backup, verify, reformat, then restore the full system.    !!
!! B: erase and install fresh Ubuntu with a limited priority restore.   !!
!! Applications and data are deleted. /etc, users, SSH keys and        !!
!! basic settings survive. There is no automatic fallback to erasure. !!
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Choose A for rclone backup/restore, or B (or y) for an ERASE install: A
